routes.name: Visa-Free Short Visit
routes.summary: Citizens of many countries, including the US, UK, Canada, Australia, Japan, South Korea, Mexico, Brazil, Argentina and most of the EU/Schengen area, need no visa for a visit. The official list is from 2018, so double check before you book.

other: Official Department of External Affairs list (last updated November 2018) shows no visa for the US, UK, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, Japan, South Korea, China, Brazil, Mexico, Argentina, Chile, Israel, South Africa, UAE and most CARICOM and EU countries.
EU/Schengen visitors: up to 90 days in a 180-day period. Some other limits are not stated.
Maximum stay for other nationalities is not on the list. Ask Immigration or a Saint Lucia mission.
Needs a valid passport. Air travelers should fill in the online immigration form up to 3 days before arrival.

sources.label: Government of Saint Lucia, visa requirements list (Dept. of External Affairs)
Saint Lucia Tourism Authority, entry form and visas

routes.name: Non-Immigrant Visa (business, tourism, study)
routes.summary: Required for nationals of some countries visiting for business, tourism or study. Apply to Immigration at least two weeks before travel. Airport applications are sometimes possible but may be refused.

other: Nationals of many countries need a visa. The official list (last updated 2018) marks some as needing it before arrival, such as Nigeria, Pakistan, Egypt and Colombia, and others as able to get it at the port of entry, such as India, Ghana, Kenya and the Philippines. Check the current list.

stay.note: Single entry valid within 3 months, or multiple entry over one year.

documents: Invitation letter if staying with someone
routes.processing: About 5 working days, per the government portal.

sources.label: Government of Saint Lucia, non-immigrant visa
Government of Saint Lucia, visa requirements list (Dept. of External Affairs)

routes.name: Citizenship by Investment: National Economic Fund
routes.summary: Contribute USD 240,000 to the National Economic Fund for citizenship for you and up to three qualifying dependents. Applications go through a licensed Authorised Agent.

investment.note: Main applicant plus up to three qualifying dependents. Extra dependents: USD 10,000 under 18, 20,000 over 18. Add-on for an existing citizen: newborn 5,000, spouse 35,000, other dependent 25,000.

other: Due diligence applies. Applications can be denied or delayed.

Qualifying dependents: spouse, children 21 or under, children up to 30 who are fully supported, disabled children or parents of any age who are fully supported, parents over 55 who are fully supported, unmarried siblings under 18
Applications must go through a licensed Authorised Agent
Main applicant interview and identity verification applies (extra fee payable by the main applicant, amount not listed)

routes.processing: About 90 days after the agent is told the application was accepted, per the FAQ. Delays are possible.

citizenship.note: The pages read do not state whether dual citizenship is allowed. Passport is issued separately after the Certificate of Registration.

routes.name: Citizenship by Investment: National Action Bond
routes.summary: Buy USD 300,000 of non-interest-bearing government bonds, held 5 years, with a USD 50,000 non-refundable admin fee. The amount is the same whatever the number of dependents.

investment.note: Any number of dependents. Non-interest-bearing government bonds held 5 years from first issue.

other: Plus USD 50,000 non-refundable administration fee and the standard processing and due diligence fees.

Qualifying dependents: spouse, children 21 or under, children up to 30 who are fully supported, disabled children or parents of any age who are fully supported, parents over 55 who are fully supported, unmarried siblings under 18
Applications must go through a licensed Authorised Agent

investment.note: Approved branded hotel/resort or boutique property. Admin fees extra.

other: Admin fees: USD 30,000 alone, 45,000 with spouse, 5,000 per child under 18, 10,000 per dependent over 18.

routes.name: Citizenship by Investment: Enterprise Project
routes.summary: Three tiers: USD 3.5 million alone, USD 6 million joint venture (at least 1 million each), or USD 250,000 for an applicant with up to three dependents plus admin fees.

investment.note: Lowest tier. Others are USD 3,500,000 alone, or USD 6,000,000 joint venture with at least USD 1,000,000 each. USD 50,000 admin fee on the first two.

other: Lowest tier admin fees: USD 15,000 alone, 20,000 with spouse, 25,000 two dependents, 30,000 three, plus 10,000 per extra dependent.
